sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about Dubai Media City Free Zone.

items.q: What is Dubai Media City (DMC) and why is it great for creative businesses?
items.a: Dubai Media City Free Zone is a strategic free zone established by TECOM Group to service media, communications, and digital companies. Home to over 2,000 companies including CNN, Sony, and Reuters, DMC is the natural environment for creative start-ups and freelancers to grow their media business with 100% ownership, a tax-free environment, and premium infrastructure.

items.q: What types of licenses are available in Dubai Media City Free Zone?
items.a: DMC offers Commercial License, Freelancer Permit, Business Information Services License, Consultancy & Retail License, Event & Leisure License, and New Media Support Services License — all tailored to different media business models.

items.q: Can freelancers and solo professionals register in DMC?
items.a: Absolutely. DMC offers Freelancer Permits specifically designed for individual creatives — writers, designers, videographers, photographers, and content creators who want legal recognition and invoicing capabilities.

items.q: What business activities can I do in DMC?
items.a: DMC hosts over 100 approved business activities including TV and film production, audio and podcasting, social media management, advertising and branding, digital marketing, PR and media consulting, event management, and publishing.

items.q: How long does it take to set up in Dubai Media City Free Zone?
items.a: Typically 3-7 working days depending on the license type, documentation, and office space selection. Our team handles everything to ensure a smooth and speedy process.

items.q: What are the legal entities available for DMC companies?
items.a: The main legal structures are Free Zone Limited Liability Company (FZ-LLC), Branch of a Foreign Company, and Freelancer Permit — each offering different benefits for different business needs.

items.q: Does DMC provide office space solutions for startups?
items.a: Yes. DMC offers co-working desks, executive furnished offices, studios and sound stages, retail spaces, and event venues — flexible options for businesses of all sizes.

items.q: Can I apply for a visa after setting up my business in DMC?
items.a: Yes. We handle establishment card issuance, immigration file opening, medical tests, Emirates ID, residency visa stamping, and family sponsorship — complete end-to-end support.

items.q: What are the setup costs in Dubai Media City Free Zone?
items.a: Costs vary based on license type, office space, and visa requirements. Contact us for a personalized quote — we offer competitive packages tailored to your budget and needs.

items.q: Is there any support after I setup with Setup Zone Dubai?
items.a: Yes. We provide ongoing support including brand creation, SEO-ready website development, CRM and CMS integration, VAT and accounting support, and business consulting for growth.
